name: Pharmacology II
description: Comprehensive study of pharmacological principles across major drug classes including cardiac respiratory renal GI and endocrine systems. Emphasis on nursing considerations side effects and patient education.

name: Medical-Surgical Nursing II
description: Advanced medical-surgical nursing concepts focusing on complex patient conditions across the lifespan. Includes perioperative care fluid and electrolyte balance and endocrine disorders.

name: Community Health Nursing
description: Population-focused nursing care including community assessment epidemiology disaster preparedness and public health interventions. Clinical placements in community settings.

name: Nursing Research Methods
description: Introduction to evidence-based practice research design and statistical analysis in nursing. Students develop a research proposal and critically evaluate published studies.

name: Pathophysiology II
description: Advanced study of pathophysiological mechanisms underlying disease processes. Focus on cardiovascular respiratory renal and endocrine system disorders and their clinical manifestations.

description: Comprehensive study of pharmacological principles. Prior semester section retained for reference.
